disposition_mapping.rationale: Extraction from the locked period is automated as a scheduled, tool-scoped process, but the council converged (pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, agentic_architect; maximalist conceded) that a reconciliation gate against the GL control total and a visible exception-escalation path to a named analyst must be a built-in function, not an implicit assumption, and that a documented manual-procedure path must exist where system integration is unavailable. The locked-period boundary itself remains the sole input per VAR-R-01 and KB-03, preserved unchanged.

Loading comparatives shares T1's trigger (period lock) and failure-handling pattern (halt-and-escalate), per agentic_architect's tool-contract reasoning, which the council converged on over the maximalist's single monolithic engine. A version-lineage check against the locked period's fiscal calendar, surfaced to a human on ambiguity, replaces silent default-resolution of comparative vintage. Approved budget version and latest forecast remain explicit inputs per VAR-R-02, with file-based handoff accepted as an equal first-class channel per emerging_economy's point.

Computation is separated architecturally from T1 (distinct trigger, distinct failure mode — parameter drift vs. data unavailability) per agentic_architect, finance_domain, and accounting_standards. The council settled a direct conflict between the maximalist's 'configuration, not something a human applies' framing and accounting_standards'/agentic_architect's requirement that any change to decomposition methodology, policy mapping, or FX rate-set be a hard precondition gate requiring genuine human attestation of its effect, not a version tag nobody reads. Accounting policies applied to actuals and constant-currency exchange rates remain mandatory inputs per VAR-R-05, VAR-R-06, and KB-06/KB-07.

Mechanical thresholding is automated, but the council unanimously preserved the analyst override path (finance_domain's 'creeping variance' case, formalized by hitl_designer and agentic_architect as a named, reason-coded, auditable action) as the real locus of residual judgment. Entity-level threshold calibration is adopted per emerging_economy to avoid a single global parameter set misreading volatile-currency entities. Kept as a distinct, addressable step with distinct actor identity to satisfy VAR-R-03, VAR-R-08, and the actor-separation requirement VAR-R-04 against T6.

This is the council's most sharply contested step. The maximalist's exception-only attestation was rejected by six of seven perspectives (pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, and the maximalist's own round-2 concession): a confidence score cannot detect commentary that is plausible but substantively wrong for reasons outside the dataset the model sees (finance_domain's backfilled-SKU example), and exception-only routing would also destroy the training signal needed to ever validate such a model safely (agentic_architect). The target state is AI-assisted drafting with mandatory, affirmative, per-variance attestation every cycle, with non-response as a distinct visible state and first-class asynchronous/offline channels (emerging_economy, hitl_designer) rather than a connectivity-dependent default.

Consolidation/formatting is automatable, but the council (finance_domain, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, emerging_economy) converged that completeness-checking is a distinct, falsifiable control against the specific real-world failure mode of silently-shipped placeholder commentary — kept separate from T4 because the two failure modes (wrong commentary vs. missing commentary) require separate root-causing.

The council decisively rejected the maximalist's exception-restricted review design: hitl_designer, agentic_architect, pragmatist (on reconsideration), finance_domain, and emerging_economy converged that full-population access must be a standing, permanent right of the reviewer, with routing used only to prioritize, never to gate, attention — the central unresolved conflict the maximalist itself named and did not win. Migration to prioritized routing is validated per entity class (emerging_economy, finance_domain) rather than on a single blanket timeline, since confidence models trained on clean data are least reliable on the noisiest entities. Remains actor-distinct from T3 per VAR-R-04, satisfying VAR-R-07's survival requirement.

Distribution is folded into T6's publication trigger for the routine case — a logged, reversible, judgment-free act, per the council's near-unanimous agreement that automated publication is sound once review clears. The maximalist's full collapse into an unconditional auto-publish was rejected: hitl_designer's and agentic_architect's refinement, that the reviewer retains a standing, logged pull-back authority to convene a walkthrough (rather than a fixed materiality-bar trigger, which pragmatist/finance_domain proposed and agentic_architect argued is a weaker, driftable governance mechanism), is adopted. Document-based distribution is retained as an equal first-class channel alongside dashboard push per emerging_economy, not a legacy fallback.

steps.description: A scoped extraction/loading process pulls actuals from the locked closed period and loads the approved budget version and latest forecast as comparatives, via API or file-based channel as the local environment requires. Each run emits a reconciliation receipt (control total tie-out against the GL) and a version-lineage confirmation (budget-version ID, forecast-cycle ID checked against the locked period's fiscal calendar). A clean pass proceeds automatically with no human touch; a reconciliation break or an ambiguous/stale comparative vintage halts the run and routes the specific discrepancy to a named FP&A analyst for resolution, who may also execute the step manually via a documented procedure with the same output contract where system integration is unavailable.
steps.name: Automated extraction and comparative loading with reconciliation and version-lineage gates

steps.description: Price, volume and mix variances are computed on actuals and comparatives prepared on the same accounting basis, with FX effects isolated at constant currency, using decomposition-methodology, policy-mapping and rate-set parameters drawn from a versioned parameter store. Routine, unchanged parameters require no human touch. Any period-over-period change to the decomposition methodology, policy mapping, or FX rate-set is a hard precondition: the engine will not execute against the new parameters until a named accountable owner attests to the change, shown the before/after effect on reported figures, not merely a version diff. Output carries the methodology and rate-set version used, surfaced to the accountable reviewer, not merely logged as unread metadata.
steps.name: Variance decomposition engine with parameter-change gate

steps.description: Variances exceeding the configured percentage or absolute materiality threshold (calibrated at entity or entity-class level to avoid uniform-currency distortion) are automatically selected for explanation. An analyst may add a below-threshold variance to the flagged list via an explicit override tool with a mandatory reason code, visibly distinguished in the output from mechanically-flagged items. This step is staffed and system-accounted distinctly from review and challenge (T6), enforced at the access-control layer, not by convention.
steps.name: Materiality-threshold flagging with override authority
outputs: Variances to explain (threshold-flagged and analyst-added, with provenance and reason codes)

steps.description: A drafting agent, scoped to read-only access on the variance decomposition and a driver-pattern library, produces a first-draft commentary with a provenance tag showing which patterns it drew on. Every flagged variance, every cycle, is routed to its accountable budget holder, who must affirmatively confirm or correct the draft; non-response is recorded as a distinct, visible 'outstanding' state and never silently resolved to implied agreement. Attestation channels include synchronous one-click interfaces and first-class asynchronous/offline/low-bandwidth modes (not a degraded fallback), with each channel producing its own provenance tag (e.g., analyst-transcribed-on-behalf-of).
steps.name: AI-drafted commentary with mandatory budget-holder attestation
outputs: Budget holder commentary (confirmed / corrected / outstanding, with provenance)

steps.description: Flagged variances and attested commentary are assembled into a draft report. A deterministic completeness check confirms every flagged item carries either an attestation record or an explicit, visible 'outstanding, escalated' marker — never a silent gap or stale placeholder. Outstanding items are escalated to a named analyst who chases the non-responsive budget holder ahead of the reporting deadline.
steps.name: Report consolidation with completeness check

steps.description: The FP&A manager reviews the draft report in a workspace that ranks the full flagged population by a routing score (anomaly confidence, prior-cycle challenge history, correction flags) but never restricts access to it: the complete population remains a standing, permanent right of the reviewer, with usage logged for recalibration purposes. Exception-based prioritization is earned and graduated per entity class through a validated migration period (full-scope review is the starting state for each entity class; routing is used only to rank attention, never to gate it). On sign-off, routine-cycle reports auto-publish to a live dashboard and/or document-based distribution channel (both first-class, neither a legacy fallback); the manager retains a standing, logged authority to pull back any report before auto-publish and convene a walkthrough. This step remains actor-distinct from thresholding (T3) per the actor-separation requirement.
steps.name: Review, challenge and distribution
